summary: Verified automatic image compression (/api/kht/upload + chunk/finish) end-to-end: large PNG 4000x3000 -> JPEG 1200x900 q85 with original/stored bytes + width/height + format fields, portrait 3000x4000 -> 900x1200, small 600x400 not upscaled, transparent PNG flattened to white (corner pixel ~255,255,255), invalid bytes -> 400 Indonesian detail, empty -> 400, chunked path returns same compression metadata (quality=85, 1200x900), GET /api/kht/files/<path> returns JPEG. AI roundtrip: downloaded a realistic Unsplash image, re-uploaded through compression endpoint, triggered Copper Strip single, DKA, and DIP Test AI analyze jobs on the newly uploaded path and polled to completion — none returned 'Image not found' (get_source_object correctly falls through master -> display). Frontend: on /copper-strip/new picking a 3000x2250 photo triggered sonner toast 'Compressed: 27KB → 30KB' with description 'Saved as JPEG 1200×900px · quality 85%' matching spec. DIP/K-HTT/Salt Spray/DKA upload only on Run Analysis per their implementation; shared uploadImage() + reportCompression() path means toast will fire after that press (backend already verified identical fields).
critical_code_review_comments: _store_compressed_upload swallows AI-master put_object exceptions silently (logger.warning). If object storage frequently 5xx's on the master copy, AI analysis quality silently degrades to the 1200px display copy without any user signal. Consider surfacing a one-time warning metric or at least count failed masters.

_handle_upload wraps *all* non-UnsupportedImage exceptions as 502 'Storage upload failed: {e}' leaking raw exception text to client (English/traceback-ish). Prefer a sanitized Indonesian detail string here as well.

downscaleBlob (frontend) uses 2000px max and quality 0.92 before sending; combined with server 1200px/q85 re-encode this is OK, but transparent PNGs are already flattened to white client-side (good) — unify defaults (constants) between frontend/backend to avoid drift.

server.py is 5998 lines — way over the 700-line guideline. Compression helpers (_scale_image/_compress_upload/_store_compressed_upload/UnsupportedImage) and upload routes should be split into backend/uploads.py.

success_rate.frontend: 100% verified module (Copper); DIP/DKA/Salt Spray/K-HTT share same uploadImage path

seed_data_creation: Uploaded 1 test image (3000x2250 jpeg) through /api/kht/upload during roundtrip test; it was consumed by copper/dka/diptest analyze jobs and left as job artifacts (not inserted into test records). No demo data modified.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend compression tests are idempotent and self-contained (synthetic PIL images). test_upload_ai_roundtrip.py pulls one Unsplash image and may take ~1 min due to AI polling. Both files can be re-run anytime. If you want to verify DIP/Salt/K-HTT/DKA toasts in the UI you must fill the required form fields and click Run Analysis then wait up to a few minutes for AI; Copper Strip fires the toast on photo pick (verified).
